name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code, made for the desktop app's Code tab.

plugins.name: git-band
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with the session's git branch, worktree, ahead/behind and changed-file counts.

plugins.name: session-files
plugins.description: A pane beside the transcript with the files this session changed, as a tree coloured by change, with each file's diff on hover and the file with its changes marked on click.
